method_definitions.fractional_track_time: Historical per-track timing; not transferable with current timing authority
method_definitions.linearized_norad_rate: Diagnostic cached-state first-order recurrent-NORAD age-rate correction
method_definitions.linearized_scan_epoch_scale1_sensitivity: Diagnostic cached-state first-order scan epochs, scale 1 s
